title: Agreement of machine encodings
statement: For every two-work-tape deterministic Turing machine $M$ with Boolean alphabet and a finite state set, the serialization of $M$ as a two-work-tape machine equals its serialization using the general $k$-tape encoding with $k=2$.
hypotheses_covered: M is a Code2TM machine, hence has two work tapes, Boolean alphabet, and state set indexed by Fin (numStates + 1)
